name: Apple M2 Pro (16- or 19-core GPU)
memory_bandwidth_basis: 200 GB/s is the figure the llama.cpp #4167 scoreboard prints for both the 16-core and 19-core GPU M2 Pro, and it is Apple's published unified-memory bandwidth for M2 Pro. One die, two GPU bins.
notes: M2 Pro as binned in the #4167 scoreboard: 16-core and 19-core GPU, both at 200 GB/s, up to 32 GB unified memory (MacBook Pro 14/16-inch and Mac mini, 2023). Distinct from apple-m2-max. memory_bus_bit is null; not back-computed from bandwidth.
